title: Annetta Knowles
subtitle: The Stained Priestess
text: She was among the highest-ranking members of the Unstained — a cleric who had given her life to purification, yet never knew she was infected. Tooth Pecks sought the infection through every ward, but Annetta understood only that the creatures would not leave her in peace. When a Harbinger turns them loose on her, the buried infection erupts and Annetta dies. The Stained Priestess that rises afterward is the infection continuing through what remains, not Annetta knowingly embracing blood power. Only an Unstained bearer of true Clarity can draw the infection out without killing her and purify her through the fight.
